perf.summary: The `s` (start) parameter is accepted but never used; BridgeAndArticulation.Find is called without it.
perf.currentCost: A dead parameter on a public API misleads callers into thinking start vertex is configurable and wastes an argument slot.
perf.proposedChange: Either remove `s` from the signature, or actually forward it to the underlying Find if single-source articulation from s is intended. Document which.
perf.rationale: Removes a misleading dead parameter, clarifying the contract; no behavioral change since s is currently ignored.
perf.risk: Signature change is API-breaking for callers passing s; if the library must stay binary-stable, keep the param but add an XML/comment noting it is reserved/ignored.

perf.summary: Five separate stackalloc arrays of size nodes=2n for Tarjan scratch; they could share a single allocation block and the per-call layout is fine but tin/low/sccId are all int[2n].
perf.currentCost: Multiple stackalloc calls (tin,low,stack,sccId int[2n] + inStack byte[2n]) issue separate stack-pointer adjustments; minor but repeated per solve.
perf.proposedChange: Coalesce into one stackalloc byte block partitioned by offset, or accept caller-provided scratch buffers (matching the Run/Try convention used elsewhere) so repeated solves reuse one allocation.
perf.rationale: Fewer stack adjustments and contiguous scratch improves locality; caller-provided buffers remove per-call setup entirely for hot repeated solves.
perf.risk: Manual partitioning must respect alignment (place all int[] before byte[] or align offsets) to avoid misaligned long/int access; otherwise behavior is unchanged.
